title: The Promise about the Dishes
youtube_title: The Promise about the Dishes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Tala is tangled up with a promise about the dishes that had not been kept yet and almost hides it. Tala tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
